mla_width.diagnostics_note: margin_in / margin_out / runner_up_* / at_cap / at_budget describe the ARGMIN rule's per-layer search, not this fixed width
mla_width.rule: m* = argmin_m D_rot_fullFisher(m) + lam-tail(B-2m) (largest m on a tie), per layer, direction order by mu; w = 2m
mla_width.rounding: median over layers of m*, half up in integers

provenance.text: mla_w64_care_sigma: mla_care_sigma built UNCHANGED (care-2026-09-30.1) at the FIXED rotary width w = 64, d_c = 448 (rule fixed:64: the four MLA arms compared at one width, the authors 2026-10-04). Any width wording below is the base module's own. -- CARE `transmla-care` content solve on TransMLA's rotary path, reimplemented from FutureMLS-Lab/CARE@3b4534644fd2c03c549b34c49c99990a6f760e3e (lora_qkv.py:156-197, 396-406, 419, 470-506; partial_rope.py:74-127) on the teacher's SIGMA (D-M5): H_z = M SIGMA M^T with M = [W~_N/alpha ; V_f] augmented, so the bias is in the metric; R = U[:, :d_c] of H_z^p W_join^T, p = 4.0 (NEW_SQRT_BASIS_POWER shipped default), solver 'stable' (eigenbasis + dgejsv JOBA='C', high relative accuracy; the release's explicit-H^p SVD is ill-posed in float64 once d_c nears rank(H_z)), damping 0.01*mean(diag H_z) in float64 (_damped_psd_eigh, lora_qkv.py:164), eigenvalue clamp 1e-08 asserted not to fire; orthonormal projection (TransMLA's gauge), canon_sign on; W_DKV = R^T M, [W_UK ; W_UV] = W_join R. alpha rule 'code' (V-slice quirk of lora_qkv.py:398 kept); w from DSTAR['mla'] and w + d_c = B, NOT CARE's qk_mqa_dim / kv_lora_rank (§0.1c); CARE-U (converter.py:203-208 refuses to save a dynamic-rank model); rotary PCA over the 8 TRUE planes only; s = sqrt((d_h+w)/d_h) in the query weights and biases, mla_scale = (d_h+w)^-1/2 (D1)
